name: COFOG functional classification
description: The United Nations' Classification of the Functions of Government, first-level divisions only. It's what makes budgets comparable across countries: every country organizes its government differently, but 'how much goes to health' means the same thing everywhere. COFOG has three levels; only the ten divisions are listed here, so publishers can still use fuller codes like 07.3 or 07.3.1 as the actual value.

hasDefinedTerm.name: General public services
hasDefinedTerm.description: Running the government itself: executive and legislative bodies, financial and fiscal affairs, foreign affairs, and public debt.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Public order and safety
hasDefinedTerm.description: Police, fire protection, courts, and prisons.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Economic affairs
hasDefinedTerm.description: Transport, agriculture, fuel and energy, communication, and general economic and labor affairs.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Environmental protection
hasDefinedTerm.description: Waste and wastewater management, pollution control, and biodiversity.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Housing and community amenities
hasDefinedTerm.description: Housing development, community development, water supply, and street lighting.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Social protection
hasDefinedTerm.description: Sickness and disability, old age, family and children, unemployment, and housing support.
